newsitem.title: USA: Health-Chem Corp Q1 net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Health-Chem Corp Q1 net loss vs profit.

text.p: Average number of common and common equivalent

NOTE: The company siad net sales for the three months ended March 31, 1997 declined to $8,743,000 from $13,149,000 in the same period in 1996 due to a decrease in sales of transdermal nitroglycerin patches and synthetic fabrics of $2.7 million and $1.8 million, respectively.

The company also said lower sales of industrial synthetic fabrics in the first quarter of 1997 as compared to the same period last year partially reflects a $1.0 million special order which was booked at the company's Pacific Combining subsidiary in the first quarter of 1996.

The company believes its financial results have been adversely impacted by delays in its receipt of approval to market its newest generation of transdermal nitroglycerin products, which are currently under review at the U.S. Food & Drug Administration.
